The 930 exact polynomial/matrix checker assertions independently verify finite algebraic certificates; no finite search is used for the infinite step quantifier.

value.rationale: The exact endpoint positivity set is a central invariant of numerical Markov dynamics. The sharp transition from unconditional strict positivity for directed cycles through five states to small-step negativity plus permanent large-step recovery at six states reveals a counterintuitive structural limitation of a classical L-stable third-order method. An exact algebraic boundary and a proof of its all-larger-cycle persistence offer practical positive-time-stepping insight without claiming an unrestricted dimension theorem.
